title: Acoustic niche hypothesis
mechanism: Species partition a shared acoustic space by vocalizing in non-overlapping frequency bands, giving every species its own channel; they share by dividing the spectrum instead of competing inside one band.
bridge_question: What if ideas could partition conceptual frequency space to avoid interference?
body: 1. **Acoustic niche hypothesis** — A soundscape ecologist studying frequency partitioning — whose work reveals that animals evolve to vocalize in non-overlapping frequency bands, creating a structured acoustic space where every species has its channel. They share by dividing. What if ideas could partition conceptual frequency space to avoid interference?
